note: Audit done from stated records plus domain knowledge; no live web verification was run in this pass. All cost/CAC figures are ASSUMPTION, Medium/Low confidence. Only cited URL (first4magnets) was not re-fetched.

verdicts.reason: Consumable repeat revenue acceptable, low capital
verdicts.moat_check: Pouch format is cloneable in weeks; no registrable barrier worth the cost. Moat real only as installed-base lock-in.
verdicts.regulatory_notes: Pet toy: GPSR applies, not Toy Safety Directive; plant material, check REACH/CLP on additives and no medical/calming claims.
verdicts.evidence_note: Costs are ASSUMPTION; at 19 EUR incl VAT net ~15, contribution after COGS 3.3, shipping, fees ~6-8 vs pet paid CAC ~15-25 (Low confidence). Pet category crowded on Amazon.

verdicts.reason: Real B2B channel via ex-VELUX installers/housing associations
verdicts.moat_check: Compatibility library is copyable but needs profile data and installer trust, which founders have. Realistic 3-6 months to build; copyist unlikely to route around B2B relationships quickly.
verdicts.regulatory_notes: Filter inserts: avoid air-quality/allergy health claims (medical-claim risk); GPSR labelling. No CE needed for passive inserts.
verdicts.evidence_note: Capital low (<2.5k). Price below 35 offset by refill and B2B low CAC; installer willingness to resell is unverified ASSUMPTION.

verdicts.reason: Low capital, refill tubes, design-led niche
verdicts.moat_check: EUR 350 registered design covers look only; tubes are simple and a copyist can alter geometry within weeks. Bee-safe tube spec plus entomologist endorsement is a credibility edge, not a barrier.
verdicts.regulatory_notes: Wood/paper: GPSR, FSC/timber sourcing (EUDR not applicable to this wood scale but check), no biocides; avoid conservation claims unsupported.
verdicts.evidence_note: bee-safe.eu critique not re-fetched. Cheap generic bee hotels dominate Amazon/garden retail (private-label risk moderate). Price 29-39 supports CAC.

verdicts.reason: Test plus housing-association channel is genuine differentiation
verdicts.moat_check: Independent tunnel test is a real cost for rivals, but tested rivals (e.g. Ornilux, Feather Friendly type products) already exist and the pattern can be redesigned; test is a credibility mark, not exclusive. 2-5k test cost and lead time (2-4 months) unverified.
verdicts.regulatory_notes: Adhesive/film: REACH, GPSR; do not claim bird protection beyond test result (consumer law, misleading claims).
verdicts.evidence_note: Test price ASSUMPTION; total outlay with test up to ~7.5k is at upper soft limit but under 10k.

verdicts.reason: Price >=35 with refill line; capital within soft limit
verdicts.moat_check: Registered design protects appearance only; tool-free disassembly mechanism copied in 6 months by changing form. Mainly a sell-through advantage.
verdicts.regulatory_notes: Food-contact for seed/suet not required for feeder, but ceramic/glass: GPSR; feed labelling under EU feed-hygiene rules for branded seed/suet (extra burden).
verdicts.evidence_note: RSPB page not re-fetched. Crowded with Gardman/Vivara/Perky-Pet style incumbents; first order 4-6k.

verdicts.reason: Copyright art plus exclusive artist licence can be a real asset, price >=35
verdicts.moat_check: Copyright stops direct art copying but not module-style knockoffs; exclusive licence is only 'potential' and must be signed before spend. Registered design 350 EUR cheap.
verdicts.regulatory_notes: Jewelry: REACH Annex XVII nickel release, cadmium, lead limits; GPSR; small parts if dice sold as game items; clear EN 1811 testing cost.
verdicts.evidence_note: Fashion-jewelry paid CAC typically 20-35 EUR vs contribution ~20 on 35 (Low confidence); Etsy competition.

verdicts.reason: High price absorbs CAC; test report differentiates in niche
verdicts.moat_check: BS 8423 report is a UK standard and any competitor can obtain one; adds trust, not exclusivity. Registered design weak.
verdicts.regulatory_notes: High product-liability exposure (children, hot surface): GPSR, liability insurance, no 'safe' absolutes; UK standard has no EU legal status; confirm EU harmonised standard route. First order up to 7.5k within soft limit.
verdicts.evidence_note: Test cost and standard applicability to stove-side guard are ASSUMPTION; verify with a test lab before commitment.

verdicts.reason: Genuine B2B channel via founders; price per window supports CAC
verdicts.moat_check: Not a legal moat; first4magnets-style kits show copyability. Size library plus installer relationships is the only barrier, 3-6 months to establish.
verdicts.regulatory_notes: Magnets: no regulated claims on energy/U-value without test; GPSR; acrylic/PET glazing REACH; consumer-law on savings claims.
verdicts.evidence_note: first4magnets URL listed in record, not re-fetched. MOQ 300 sets within first-order limit; custom sizing raises return/complexity risk.

verdicts.reason: Weak copyright moat, generic yarn, price 24-29 below 35 and paid CAC exceeds first-order contribution
verdicts.moat_check: Pattern copyright does not stop competing kits; copyist can ship equivalent patterns in weeks.
verdicts.regulatory_notes: Needles (sharp item) GPSR; no strong exposure.
verdicts.evidence_note: Assumptions only; craft-kit market crowded on Etsy/Amazon.

verdicts.reason: Founder ex-VELUX sill data is a genuine niche edge, price 39-49
verdicts.moat_check: Registered design plus roof-window fit data is hard to replicate generally but small market means few copyists; utility model might be stronger than design. Moderate.
verdicts.regulatory_notes: Pet furniture: GPSR, load/stability and clamp-damage risks to window frames; avoid claims about VELUX compatibility (trademark use).
verdicts.evidence_note: Search volume for roof-window perches is small (ASSUMPTION), so reach via roof-window owner communities and installers.

verdicts.reason: No moat; stationery dominated by Moleskine/Leuchtturm/Midori and Amazon private label, refill lock-in needs large installed base
verdicts.moat_check: Proprietary size/binding offers no protection against a differently sized rival; design registration trivial to avoid.
verdicts.regulatory_notes: Magnets in covers: GPSR small-magnet hazards if marketed to children.
verdicts.evidence_note: Price 22-29 under 35, paid CAC exceeds contribution.

verdicts.reason: Own record states no moat; compatible blades flooded by cheap Amazon/AliExpress generics and OEM supply
verdicts.moat_check: Compatibility database copied instantly; subscription reminder adds nothing a seller cannot replicate.
verdicts.regulatory_notes: Cutting blades: GPSR/Machinery safety, OEM brand-name use risk (trademark); no CE alone but fitment liability.
